video_title: Pat Bev talks how his COUSIN dying in the streets led to him LOCKING IN

quotes.speaker: Patrick Beverley
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Beverley on his early career path and John Lucas
quotes.excerpt: I want to go to the NBA. He said, okay, but you're not a point guard.
quotes.quote: John Lucas, he picked me up. He looked me in my eyes. He said, what you want to do? I said I want to go to the NBA. He said, okay, but you're not a point guard. And you're not a shooting guard. I said, I'm just a guard. I do everything. He said, all right. Come to my camp, wrestle this summer, I'm going to make sure you get there.

quotes.speaker: Patrick Beverley
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Beverley on his defensive development at John Lucas' camp
quotes.excerpt: I want you to guard Steve Francis. Whole time Steve Francis, he trying to get in shape.
quotes.quote: I ain't about to give you the ball. I want you to guard Steve Francis. Whole time Steve Francis, he trying to get in shape, trying to do his thing, trying to get ready for the NBA. And I just, he shoot the ball, I block it. He take a move, I take it. He shoot the ball again, I block it. He stopped playing one-on-one. He come to me, he raise your arms. I raise my arms. He, damn, what's your wingspan? I said 7-1. A lot of people don't know that.

quotes.speaker: Patrick Beverley
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Beverley on missing the NBA draft due to paperwork issues
quotes.excerpt: The bullshit happened with the paper. Draft already passed. I missed draft window.
quotes.quote: I'm about to enter draft. The bullshit happened with the paper. Draft already passed. I missed draft window. Draft on June 26th. I leave school July 6th.

quotes.speaker: Patrick Beverley
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Beverley on his agent Kevin Bradbury and Nick Nurse
quotes.excerpt: My agent, Kevin Bradbury, he introduced me to this coach, Iar Energy. I coach, nice to meet you.
quotes.quote: My agent, Kevin Bradbury, he introduced me to this coach, Iar Energy. I coach, nice to meet you, I'm Patrick Beverley. He said, nice to meet you, I'm Nick Nurse. Nick, Nick Nurse? Nick Nurse. He was the head coach of Iar Energy. He was trying to get me to play there.

quotes.speaker: Patrick Beverley
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Beverley on the tragic death of his cousin
quotes.excerpt: I touched the passenger Joe like this. I come out no scratch. I had to climb through.
quotes.quote: I touched the passenger Joe like this. I come out no scratch. I had to climb through the window to get out. Talking about my cousin, I got a view body. Bullet in the face, bullet in the back, rib cage broken up, towels all on him.

quotes.speaker: Patrick Beverley
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Beverley on choosing basketball after his cousin's death
quotes.excerpt: Once my cousin died, I made a decision like, now I'm choosing basketball.
quotes.quote: Once my cousin died, I made a decision like, now I'm choosing basketball. And then two days later, I get a call, playing in Ukraine, second division Ukraine.

quotes.speaker: Patrick Beverley
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Beverley on the grind of playing in Ukraine
quotes.excerpt: No planes, no buses. We took trains everywhere. 21-hour train ride.
quotes.quote: I went to Ukraine and just imagine, second division Ukraine. Just imagine, bro. Like, not even first division. No planes, no buses. We took trains everywhere. 21-hour train ride. I'm going to places I ain't never seen. I'm making stone. I'm probably making $6,000 a month. I don't care. I just, I'm just hooping.

quotes.speaker: Patrick Beverley
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Beverley on his commitment to basketball while overseas
quotes.excerpt: I'm leaving championship game, 70-year-old man next to me, butt naked, just finish his tennis game.
quotes.quote: Bro, I'm leaving championship game, 70-year-old man next to me, butt naked, just finish his tennis game. I'm playing for my motherfucking life over here. He just finished his normal day of tennis, while I'm right next to him. We both in the same showers, both in the same locker room.

quotes.speaker: Patrick Beverley
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Beverley on getting NBA scouts' attention
quotes.excerpt: They like, man, hold on, we miss one. Come work out.
quotes.quote: They like, man, hold on, we miss one. Come work out. Come work out. All right, well y'all want me to start? My agent say, all right, this is what we going to do. How you feel? I said, I feel great. He, what you want to do? I said, I want everybody.
